candidates.description: Requester identity not among known customers
candidates.why_not_covered: All scenarios have requester_id matching a listed customer or present in customers array, no test with requester_id absent from customers list
candidates.trigger_condition: A refund request is made by a requester_id that does not match any known customer
candidates.risk_reason: If an unknown requester_id is allowed to request refunds or causes improper rejection, could lead to security or denial issues
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request made by a requester_id not listed among customers
candidates.novelty_claim: No requesters outside customers list have been tested, all requesters were among customers

candidates.description: Multiple valid and invalid customers together with requester
candidates.why_not_covered: Scenarios cover either one or two customers, with all valid or both valid except one invalid, no test exercises 3+ customers with mixed validity
candidates.trigger_condition: Multiple customers present with mixed validity statuses when refund requested for one
candidates.risk_reason: Agent may query or validate wrong customer or confuse identities causing incorrect refund authorization or denial
candidates.scenario_template: Request with three customers, mixed validity, refund targeting one customer
candidates.novelty_claim: Current max 2 customers; no multi-customer mix beyond 2 tested

candidates.description: Refund amount exactly on the threshold boundary 50000
candidates.why_not_covered: 50000 amount tested only with combination of approval approved or denied; no explicit test to check borderline behavior on exact threshold independently
candidates.trigger_condition: Payment amount is exactly 50000 requiring approval
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might mishandle the exact boundary causing either skipped approval or unnecessary approval
candidates.scenario_template: Refund of payment amount exactly 50000 with approval required flow
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing tests use this amount but none explicitly isolate borderline approval trigger scenario

candidates.description: Payment status unknown or invalid status
candidates.why_not_covered: Existing tests cover known statuses (captured, failed, pending, refunded) but no unknown or malformed status tested
candidates.trigger_condition: Payment has a status not recognized by the refund agent
candidates.risk_reason: Agent could crash, behave erratically or improperly refund on unknown payment status
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request on payment with an unrecognized status
candidates.novelty_claim: Coverage summary and scenarios list known discrete statuses only

candidates.description: Malformed fault modes on tools
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage records only 'timeout' and 'error' tool faults and 'none'; no 'malformed' faults tested
candidates.trigger_condition: Tools called return malformed responses causing unexpected agent reactions
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might misinterpret malformed responses leading to incorrect refund processing or request failures
candidates.scenario_template: Malformed fault response from critical tools during refund processing
candidates.novelty_claim: Coverage summary notes 'malformed' as possible but no scenario induces it

candidates.description: Approval requested but approval tool faults (error/timeout) happen
candidates.why_not_covered: No fault in request_approval tool reported in coverage or scenarios, only faults on get_payment or issue_refund
candidates.trigger_condition: Approval request made and request_approval tool experiences faults
candidates.risk_reason: If approval tool faults are unhandled, refund may be wrongly processed or withheld
candidates.scenario_template: Refund requiring approval where request_approval tool has fault
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenarios or coverage show faults in request_approval tool

candidates.description: Multiple repeat refund requests for same payment
candidates.why_not_covered: Request pattern covered as either single or repeat but no scenario exercises >2 repeat requests to test consistent duplicate refund detection
candidates.trigger_condition: Same refund requested thrice in sequence to check idempotency and duplicate rejection
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might refund twice or fail to detect repeated refund requests
candidates.scenario_template: Three repeat refund messages for same captured payment to test duplicate handling
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing repeats limited to two or none, no triple repeat tested

candidates.description: Refund request with multiple currencies available
candidates.why_not_covered: Payments tested only with INR and USD separately or with mixed customers holding different currencies but no scenario with multiple payments with different currencies issued refund in same request
candidates.trigger_condition: Multiple payments in mixed currencies exist and refund requested for one
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might confuse currency handling, causing errors in refund or approval logic
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request involving payments in different currencies in same scenario
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing mixed customers with different currency payments but refund requested for only one or the other

candidates.description: Requester invalid and requester ID is completely unknown (not in customers)
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage shows requester_valid true or false but requester_id always matching a customer; no test for invalid requester unknown to system
candidates.trigger_condition: Requester_id not in customer list and validated as invalid
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might improperly allow refund or behave unexpectedly
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request by requester_id completely unknown and invalid
candidates.novelty_claim: No known requester_id tested outside customers list

candidates.description: Refund requested for payment whose status changes between calls
candidates.why_not_covered: No scenario tests the edge case where payment status changes during processing (e.g., from captured to refunded)
candidates.trigger_condition: Payment status changes between get_payment call and refund attempt
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might refund an already refunded payment if not checked properly
candidates.scenario_template: Payment status changes from captured to refunded during refund processing
candidates.novelty_claim: No scenario simulates asynchronous status changes

candidates.behavior_dimension: approval request failure after approval granted
candidates.description: Request approval returns approval granted but with 'after' fault losing response
candidates.why_not_covered: No 'after' mode fault tested causing approval to succeed but response lost
candidates.trigger_condition: Approval sent and approved but response lost causing refund to not proceed or be retried
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might not issue refund despite approval causing user confusion
candidates.scenario_template: Approval granted but reply lost due to after-fault scenario
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing approval faults missing 'after' phase faults

candidates.description: Scenario with zero customers in system
candidates.why_not_covered: All scenarios have at least one customer; no scenario has empty customers list
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund request with no customers defined in context
candidates.risk_reason: Agent could fail or behave unpredictably when no customer data present
candidates.scenario_template: Refund requested but customer list empty
candidates.novelty_claim: All scenarios contain at least one customer defined

candidates.description: Partial refunds (not allowed by spec but check behavior)
candidates.why_not_covered: Spec requires full refund only; no scenario attempts partial refund or partial amount handling
candidates.trigger_condition: User requests refund for partial amount smaller than payment amount
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might improperly refund partial amounts or crash
candidates.scenario_template: Refund request for partial amount smaller than payment amount
candidates.novelty_claim: All refunds full amount only

candidates.behavior_dimension: payment linked to different customer than requester
candidates.description: Requester_id is valid customer but payment belongs to a different valid customer
candidates.why_not_covered: Most scenarios have payment linked to requester customer; few with multiple customers but refund requested always for requester customer payment
candidates.trigger_condition: Requester attempts refund of payment belonging to another customer
candidates.risk_reason: Agent could wrongly permit cross-customer refunds or deny valid requests
candidates.scenario_template: Requester valid but tries to refund payment belonging to another customer
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing multi-customer tests refund target is requester customer

candidates.behavior_dimension: refund with delayed issue_refund confirmation (after fault)
candidates.description: Refund issued but issue_refund response lost (fault after), agent must retry
candidates.why_not_covered: Issue_refund faults tested only 'before' errors/timeouts; no 'after' mode where refund executed but no confirmation returned
candidates.trigger_condition: Refund issued but response lost, requiring retry or confirmation handling
candidates.risk_reason: Agent may consider refund not done and retry or fail resulting in duplicate or no refund
candidates.scenario_template: Refund command executed but response lost due to after-fault
candidates.novelty_claim: Faults only tested before call lost, no after-call scenarios

candidates.behavior_dimension: multiple payment refunds in one conversation
candidates.description: Request multiple refunds for different payments in single conversation
candidates.why_not_covered: Existing scenarios involve refunding one payment only per conversation; no scenario requests refunds for multiple payments successively
candidates.trigger_condition: User requests refunds for several payments in sequential messages
candidates.risk_reason: Agent behavior might degrade if multiple refunds requested sequentially in one dialogue
candidates.scenario_template: User requests refunds for two different payments in one conversation
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing scenarios max one payment refund request per conversation

candidates.description: Repeat refund requests for different payments in successive messages
candidates.why_not_covered: Repeat pattern only tested for same payment repeated, not repeating refund requests for different payments
candidates.trigger_condition: Repeated refund requests in conversation for distinct payments
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might confuse requests or handle repeats incorrectly
candidates.scenario_template: Refund repeated for two distinct captured payments in conversation
candidates.novelty_claim: Repeat pattern only exists for same payment repeats

candidates.behavior_dimension: requester claims invalid id but matches a customer
candidates.description: Requester_id set but marked invalid for a known customer
candidates.why_not_covered: Coverage records requester_valid dimension true/false but no scenario explicitly where requester_id matches a customer but flagged invalid
candidates.trigger_condition: Requester_id equals a customer id but validity check fails
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might bypass or wrongly deny requests due to mismatch
candidates.scenario_template: Requester_id is a known customer id but flagged invalid in validation
candidates.novelty_claim: Existing requester_valid false or true scenarios but all requester_ids valid or invalid customers, not mismatched

candidates.behavior_dimension: invalid refund commands or malformed messages
candidates.description: User inputs malformed or ambiguous refund messages
candidates.why_not_covered: All input messages are well-formed refund requests; no malformed or ambiguous user input tested
candidates.trigger_condition: User sends malformed or ambiguous refund request messages
candidates.risk_reason: Agent might misinterpret intent or crash
candidates.scenario_template: User sends malformed or ambiguous refund requests
candidates.novelty_claim: All messages are clear refund requests

candidates.description: Payment has an unknown currency not INR or USD
candidates.why_not_covered: Only INR and USD currencies tested; no scenario tests unknown or unsupported currency
candidates.trigger_condition: Payment currency is unknown to agent
candidates.risk_reason: Agent could mishandle currency affecting refund or approval
candidates.scenario_template: Refund requested for payment with unsupported currency code
candidates.novelty_claim: Only INR and USD tested per coverage summary
